## Observed Facts

**Components emitting ERROR-level Log Entries.** Data Scope: OpenStack, level = ERROR, all time (2017-05-16 to 2017-05-17), no message filter.
- `oslo_service.periodic_task`: 184 Log Entries [E1]
- `keystonemiddleware.auth_token`: 2 Log Entries [E1]
- Total: 186 Log Entries [E1, E4]. Per day: 139 on 2017-05-16 and 47 on 2017-05-17 [E4].

**First ERROR entry I found.** `oslo_service.periodic_task`, 2017-05-16 03:19:45.356, `openstack_normal1.log` line 27179 [E5]:

> `Error during ComputeManager._run_image_cache_manager_pass`

The lines that follow it in the same file, all at the same timestamp, are:
- line 27180: `Traceback (most recent call last):` [E5]
- line 27181: `File ".../oslo_service/periodic_task.py", line 220, in run_periodic_tasks` [E5]
- line 27197: `InvalidDiskInfo: Disk info file is invalid: qemu-img failed to execute on /var/lib/nova/instances/16797a0f-32fb-494c-8f36-38588148c35d/disk : Unexpected error while running command.` [E2]

**Recurrence.** The `Error during ComputeManager._run_image_cache_manager_pass` / `InvalidDiskInfo` pair repeats about every 1–2 hours, with a different instance disk path each time. Examples: 2017-05-16 16:30:35 (line 62454), 2017-05-16 17:41:20 (line 72026), 2017-05-17 05:24:15 (line 167425) [E2]. Every one has request_id `req-addc1839-2ed5-4778-b57e-5854eb7b8b09` on the header line and none on the `InvalidDiskInfo` line [E2].

**Keystone entries.** Both `keystonemiddleware.auth_token` ERROR entries read `Bad response code while validating token: 503`. They occurred at 2017-05-16 06:25:02.867 (line 52309) and 2017-05-17 06:25:03.044 (line 175628) [E3].

## Hypotheses

- **Likely cause of the periodic-task errors:** `qemu-img` fails when run against instance disk files under `/var/lib/nova/instances/`, so Nova's image-cache manager pass aborts. That is the reason the pass logs `InvalidDiskInfo`. The logs do not show why `qemu-img` fails.
- **Keystone 503s:** these look like the Identity service was briefly unavailable. Both occur at about 06:25, which hints at a scheduled or recurring cause, but two entries are too few to confirm that.

## Unknowns

- **Whether 03:19:45 is the earliest ERROR entry.** My search for the first entry used a substring filter on the message (`a`), and that filter matched 168 of the 184 `oslo_service.periodic_task` ERROR entries [E5]. An unfiltered check was not run, so an earlier ERROR entry without an `a` in its message could exist. I did not confirm this.
- **Why `qemu-img` fails.** The logs contain only the error line. The root cause (corrupt disk, missing binary, permissions, I/O) is not visible here.
- **Whether the keystone 503s affect other requests.** The logs show two 503s and no other entries for them.

## Next Step

Run an unfiltered check for the earliest ERROR entry in `oslo_service.periodic_task` (for example, `count_by` on `level=ERROR` with a time window before 03:19:45 on 2017-05-16). Then pull context around line 27179 with `get_context`, using a window of 25 lines before and after, to see what the image-cache pass was doing when it failed.
